zh.title: 聯合航空預計2027年於部分廣體客機推出經濟艙臥舖
zh.summary: 聯合航空計劃於2027年在特定廣體客機推出經濟艙臥舖產品
body: 根據 Simple Flying 的報導，聯合航空（United Airlines）計劃於 2027 年推出全新的經濟艙臥舖產品。該項客艙產品預計將配備在聯合航空旗下選定的廣體客機上。
這項新型經濟艙臥舖產品在公佈後，獲得了大尺碼乘客的讚賞與正面評價。該名乘客對聯合航空推出的經濟艙臥舖設計給予了高度肯定。
聯合航空規劃將這項經濟艙臥舖產品於 2027 年正式推出，屆時部署將涵蓋該航空公司選定的廣體客機機隊。

en.title: United Airlines Plans 2027 Economy Bed Launch on Select Widebody Aircraft
en.summary: United Airlines plans to launch new economy beds on select widebody aircraft in 2027.
body: According to a news report published by Simple Flying, United Airlines is preparing to launch a new economy bed product in 2027. The product is scheduled to be introduced on select widebody aircraft within the United Airlines fleet.

The planned economy bed offering has drawn praise from a plus-size passenger, who expressed appreciation for the United Airlines cabin product. The passenger praised the airline for developing the new economy class seating option.
United Airlines plans to roll out the economy bed product in 2027, with installation targeted for selected widebody aircraft operated by the carrier.

zh.title: 塞佩罕航空737客機伊朗衝出跑道前起落架塌陷
zh.summary: 塞佩罕航空客機於馬什哈德降落後衝出跑道；機上127人安全疏散無人受傷
body: 伊朗塞佩罕航空（Sepehran Airlines）一架波音737-500客機於2026年8月25日在伊朗馬什哈德國際機場（MHD）降落後衝出跑道。該班機航班號為IS4310，由德黑蘭梅赫拉巴德機場（THR）飛抵馬什哈德。客機降落後偏離鋪設跑道並駛入未鋪設區域，最終造成機鼻著地、前起落架塌陷。
機上共載有127名乘客與機組人員，事發後均已安全疏散，未收到任何人員受傷報告。受到涉事客機停擺影響，馬什哈德國際機場發布通告，暫時關閉13R跑道以及Q滑行道。
伊朗民用航空組織表示，該客機在降落前未曾接獲任何技術故障通報，降落過程最初屬正常狀態。然而客機在高速動態下向左偏離跑道並進入草地區域。伊朗當局已派遣專業調查小組前往現場，以釐清衝出跑道與起落架損壞的原因。
涉事客機註冊編號為EP-FSF，為1992年5月製造的波音737-529機型。該機最早交付比利時國家航空（Sabena）服役，隨後曾先後營運於烏克蘭空中之航（AeroSvit）、烏克蘭國際航空、印尼廖內航空（Riau Airlines）及卡爾星航空（Kalstar Aviation），並於2016年加入塞佩罕航空機隊。
伊朗各航空公司長期在面對嚴格限制下維持高齡西方客機運作，塞佩罕航空機隊主要由波音737-300與737-500組成。此外，美國財政部於事故前一日（8月24日）宣佈對伊朗航空業實施新一輪經濟制裁，不過塞佩罕航空未被列入該批具體制裁名單中。

en.title: Sepehran Airlines 737 Veers Off Runway in Iran with Nose Gear Collapse
en.summary: Sepehran Airlines 737 veers off runway in Iran; 127 passengers and crew evacuate safely without injuries.
body: A Sepehran Airlines Boeing 737-500 veered off the runway after landing at Mashhad International Airport (MHD) in Iran on August 25, 2026. Flight IS4310 was arriving from Tehran Mehrabad Airport (THR) when the aircraft departed the paved surface following what officials described as a normal landing approach.

No injuries were reported among the 127 passengers and crew members on board, all of whom evacuated safely after the aircraft came to a stop. Images from the scene showed the aircraft resting nose-down in an unpaved area with its nose landing gear collapsed. The disabled aircraft prompted airport authorities to temporarily close Runway 13R and Taxiway Q at Mashhad.

Iran's Civil Aviation Organization stated that no technical issues had been reported by the flight crew prior to landing. According to official reports, the aircraft veered to the left while traveling at high speed on the runway before entering the unpaved field. Iranian aviation authorities have dispatched an investigation team to Mashhad to determine the cause of the runway excursion.

The aircraft involved in the accident is registered as EP-FSF, a Boeing 737-529 manufactured in May 1992. Originally delivered to Belgian carrier Sabena as OO-SYJ, the jet later flew for AeroSvit, Ukraine International Airlines, Riau Airlines, and Kalstar Aviation before joining Sepehran Airlines in 2016.

Iranian carriers have kept aging Western-built aircraft operational despite long-standing international restrictions that limit access to new airframes and spare parts. Sepehran operates a fleet composed mainly of Boeing 737-300 and 737-500 aircraft on domestic and regional routes. The incident occurred one day after the United States Treasury Department announced expanded economic sanctions targeting Iran's aviation sector, although Sepehran was not specifically named in that announcement.

zh.title: 台灣首批2架F-16V Block70戰機啟程赴台
zh.summary: 首批2架F-16V Block 70戰機已啟程赴台；目前停留關島等待天氣
body: 根據航太全球新聞報導，台灣採購66架洛克希德馬丁F-16V戰機中的首批2架已啟程飛往台灣。報導引述自由時報指出，這兩架F-16V Block 70戰機（編號6727與6728）已途經夏威夷，目前停留在關島。
報導稱，這兩架戰機目前仍在關島，等待良好天氣條件後飛往台灣的台東空軍基地。報導提到，抵達台灣後將立即展開地面測試與換裝訓練。
報導指洛克希德馬丁預計在2027年及2028年陸續交付其餘63架戰機。報導也指出，台灣在2020年下單時，原訂66架全數於2026年底前交付，但因產線搬運與供應鏈中斷導致延宕。

en.title: First two of 66 F-16V Block 70 fighters depart for Taiwan
en.summary: First two of 66 F-16V Block 70 jets depart for Taiwan; currently in Guam awaiting weather
body: Aerospace Global News reports that the first two of Taiwan's 66 Lockheed Martin F-16V fighters have departed for Taiwan. Citing Taiwan's Liberty Times, the report says the two F-16V Block 70 jets, serial numbers 6727 and 6728, transited through Hawaii and are currently in Guam.

The report says the two jets remain in Guam, awaiting favorable weather conditions to fly to Taiwan's Taitung Air Force Base. After arrival, they will immediately begin ground testing and conversion training.

According to the article, Lockheed Martin expects to deliver the remaining 63 fighters through 2027 and 2028. The report also notes Taiwan initially expected all 66 F-16s delivered by the end of 2026, but production ramp-up has caused delays.
